hypothesis: Peripheral-fact mining (coverage lever). Exp5 two-pass extraction picks one HEADLINE fact per source passage and drops secondary facts embedded within longer answers, so RAG refuses on topics whose facts ARE in the sampled source but were never turned into pairs (e.g. subpopulations affected, secondary benefits, comparative stats). Change: PASS 1 now also mines those distinct secondary facts, and QA_PER_SOURCE 8->10 gives room for them. Strict grounding kept (every mined fact must be verbatim-supported). Distinct from Exp3 (raised count on the OLD single-pass prompt with no secondary-fact instruction, which padded/diluted) and Exp8 (forced external categories not in source).
